# Phase 9 plane census — the family by **caller**

*Generated by `rust/tools/phase9_plane_callers.py`; the tables below are its
output. Regenerate before quoting (S24).*

`phase9_census.md` classifies each tagged site by its **signature**. That is the wrong
instrument for scoping the plane family, and F103 is why: `pure` is a property of
the signature, not of the call sites. So this section reads the other end — every
call site of a raw plane entry point, with each pointer-valued argument
classified by **which surface it names**:

| class | surface | why it is or is not convertible now |
|---|---|---|
| `src` | the spatial **source** picture | read-only for the whole frame — any number of shared `PlaneCursor`s, on any number of threads, is sound |
| `ref` | a **reference** picture | same |
| `rec` | the **reconstruction** picture | **written by every worker of the fork**, at macroblock granularity that is not row-contiguous — cannot become one `&mut [u8]` per worker (F73, and §9 below) |
| `cache` | an `SMbCache`-owned buffer | single-owner scratch, but reached through `md::mem_pred_*` raw accessors — **family 3's** (session D) |
| `coeff` | a DCT/quant coefficient block | **family 3's** as well (F103) |
| `local` | a caller stack array | single-owner |

A site's verdict is the latest family any of its operands waits on:
`blocked` (reconstruction) > `coeff` > `safe-now`.

60 kernel-internal composition calls are excluded from the counts: the composite
shims build the big shapes out of the small ones (`WelsSampleSad16x16_c` sums four
8x8 quadrants), and those calls disappear with the shims rather than needing a
caller conversion. `--internal` lists them.

`in-fork` is an over-approximation on purpose — reachability follows every
dispatch slot and every file-scope function table, so a preprocessing step that
shares a slot with the encode tree reads as `in-fork`
(`processing/scene_change_detection.rs:87` is the one such row). A false
`in-fork` costs caution; a false `ST-only` would cost soundness.

## 2. What the table decides, group by group

| group | sites | verdict | what gates it |
|---|---:|---|---|
| **sad / sad4 / satd / md_cost / me_cost** | **37** | `safe-now` **on plane operands only** | but 25 of the 37 pair a `src`/`ref` operand with a **`cache`** one, so the table cannot flip until family 3 lands — see §3 |
| **mc** (`McLuma_c` / `McChroma_c`) | 23 | `safe-now` | `ref` x `cache`; same family-3 gate |
| **dct** (`PDctFunc`) | 13 | `coeff` — **all of them** | the `pDct` operand is `md::coeff_level(pMbCache)` / `md::dct(pMbCache)`, an SMbCache walking cursor. **F103's shape exactly**, and it corrects session B's brief, which scoped the DCT table as "source picture (safe) + prediction buffer (owned) -> safe now" and did not count the coefficient parameter |
| **copy** (`PCopyFunc`) | 21 | 17 `blocked`, 4 `safe-now` | the destination is the **reconstruction** plane at every reconstruction site; the four exceptions are `VaaBackgroundMbDataUpdate` (x3, `src` -> `ref`) and `MeRefineFracPixel`'s `pfCopyBlockByMode` |
| **intrapred** (`PGetIntraPredFunc`) | 5 | `blocked` — **all of them** | `pRef` is the reconstruction picture at every call site |

## 3. The finding that scopes the session (F104)

**Every cost-table call site is safe on its plane operands and 25 of 37 are not
convertible, because the other operand is an `SMbCache` prediction buffer.**
The cost tables are one type each, so re-typing `pfSampleSad` / `pfSampleSatd` /
`pfSample4Sad` to safe function pointers is atomic across all 37 sites — and it
cannot happen until *both* the plane roots (source/reference through the pools)
and the `SMbCache` buffers (family 3) are safe. Twelve sites are `src` x `ref`
only (`svc_motion_estimate.rs` x10, `CalUVSadCost`, `scene_change_detection.rs`)
and would convert on the plane roots alone; they cannot go first because the slot
type is shared.

The same gate holds for `mc` (23 sites, all `ref` x `cache`) and for `dct`
(13 sites, all `coeff`). So **`common/sad_common.rs`, `common/mc.rs` and
`encoder/sample.rs` cannot reach `#![deny(unsafe_code)]` before family 3**, which
is later than both the charter's §4 and session B's brief assume.

## 4. Slots passed as values, not called (`--handoff`)

Re-typing a cost slot re-types every signature that carries one. 42 sites do:
`pfCalculateSatd` takes a `pfSampleSatd` slot as its first argument
(`svc_motion_estimate.rs:587`, `:632`, `:676`), the four search entry points hoist
one into a local before the loop, `SFeatureSearchIn::pSad` **stores** one
(`:1400`), and `SSampleDealingFunc::md_cost` / `me_cost` return one
(`md.rs:755`, `:770`). These are not call sites and carry no operands, so they do
not appear in 8.1; they are work the same commit has to do.

## 5. The per-macroblock carrier `SPicData`

`SMbCache::SPicData` (`encoder_context.rs:157`) is read at **120** sites, not the
124 the brief states:

| field | surface | uses | conversion |
|---|---|---:|---|
| `pEncMb` | source | 49 | needs the source picture reachable where it is read |
| `pRefMb` | reference | 29 | reachable from the layer today — `layer_ref_pic(pLayer)` |
| `pCsMb` | reconstruction | 30 | **blocked** (`phase9_findings.md` F107) |
| `pDecMb` | reconstruction | 12 | **blocked** (`phase9_findings.md` F107) |

by file: `svc_base_layer_md.rs` 61, `svc_mode_decision.rs` 32,
`svc_encode_slice.rs` 9, `svc_encode_mb.rs` 5, `get_intra_predictor.rs` 1.

**Ten of the consumers take `pCurDqLayer: *mut SDqLayer` and no context**
(`WelsMdI16x16`, `WelsMdIntraChroma`, `WelsMdP16x16`, `WelsMdP16x8`, `WelsMdP8x16`,
`WelsMdP8x8`, `WelsMdP8x4`, `WelsMdP4x8`, `WelsMdP4x4`, `WelsRecPskip`), which the
layer's own doc comment already records. The **reference** picture is reachable
from the layer (`SDqLayer::pRefPic` + `pRefList`, i.e. `layer_ref_pic`); the
**source** picture is not — the layer holds only the raw `pEncData[3]` roots, and
the spatial pool lives in `pVpp`. So converting `pEncMb` needs a source-picture
handle on the layer (`pEncPic: Option<SrcPicId>`, stamped in
`WelsInitCurrentLayer` beside `pEncData`, `encoder_ext.rs:2148-2165`) and a route
to the pool, exactly as `pRefList` is the route for the reconstruction pool.
